Hero_Desc_Mayo:
A sprite who specializes in collecting things.
She collects anything unique, so much so that she even set up her own stolen goods shop. It's said that anything you give to Mayo is hard to get back.
Album_Like_Mayo: Her collectibles which move 'no more'. Photos.
Album_Hobby_Mayo: Making brochure for her stolen goods shop.
Album_Wish_Mayo: Owning a rare item that's never been heard of or seen.
Album_Mayo1: Mayo is a sprite with sinister side, despite her outer appearance. Sometimes her comments give me goosebumps, but Erpin, along with the other sprites, assured me that Mayo may speak in a unique way, but not to worry about it.
Album_Mayo2: I was very taken aback when Mayo wanted to show me her 'neck collection.' And, with her characteristic dark smile, when she said she wanted to add 'my neck' to her collection, I made some weird excuse and split.
Album_Mayo3: Later, I was little relieved when Erpin explained that Mayo's so-called neck collection is actually a collection of plaster casts, modeled after the busts of sprites. Furthermore, since Mayo was so good at shooting an arrow, I also asked her how she became so adept. She replied she 'learned to shoot tranquilizer arrows from a safe distance.' When I probed her on what she meant, she said tranquilizing a worried face full of wrinkles makes it easier to do 'artistic taxidermy.'
Album_Mayo4: I would later ask the other sprites what Mayo mean by 'artistic taxidermy.' Simply put, it's a strange way to say an image or a photo. Hearing the explanation left me a little... relieved, for lack of a better word. Why... the tranquilizer?
Album_Mayo5: Every time Mayo sees me, she comments, 'A collection to hold onto,' whenever she has a chance. I feel... unsure whether to feel flattered or concerned, leaving me to feel Mayo's presence wherever I go.
Album_Mayo6: Being stalked by Mayo isn't exactly pleasant, but thanks to this, it has surprisingly helped me avoid dangers quite often. Whenever something comes up in Elias Forest, Mayo mysteriously appears to protect me.
Album_Mayo7: I thanked Mayo for protecting me. She looked a little flustered... how cute. I asked her if she's exhausted from following me around, and she replied that the collection value would drop if the "packaging" got damaged. Uh, packaging...?

Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Hate1: Mayo didn't even bother looking at it, saying this bread was pedestrian, tasteless, and not worth the money.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Hate2: She looked at me with pity, asking how picking up stones, wrapping them, and then selling them would make them seem rare.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like1: In her characteristic way of speaking, Mayo thanked me and took the food to go, saying she would make it a family heirloom.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like2: Mayo said the value of this drink would increase over time, so she took a little drink and kept it.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like3: Mayo said eating this food clears her headache, marveling at its effectiveness.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like4: As soon as she saw them, she put them, one by one, by color, in a preservation solution. After the sorting process was over, she casually ate them.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like5: I felt like she wanted something other than food, but she ate without many complaints.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like6: Mayo placed high value on its unique design. She then took it away vacuum-packed without even tasting it.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like7: Mayo pouted about hot food being hard to 'preserve.' I told her I'd set some aside for preservation and urged her to eat it.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like8: Mayo said she needed to collect all the Almond Pralines, snatching away what she could find. When I asked what she was munching on, she handed me an emergency Almond Praline she had made herself.
Food_ChefNote_Mayo_Like9: Mayo treated the candy like a rare collection, not even tasting it before deciding to take it home. She seemed to handle it very preciously.

LoveLetter_Mayo: To the Master. Heard you've been busy running around lately. Don't like my collectibles getting scratched or touched by others. The packaging must stay intact. So, stay within the Order. This is a courtesy, considering you have social standing and deserve respect. Understood? So, stop wandering about and stay within the confines of the Order. Never forget. You are my precious.
LoveCall_Mayo:
Greetings, Collectible. It is time for our regular contact.
What does 'regular contact' mean? Exactly what it says.
You are always rushing around so busily that I cannot properly track where you are...
so I will contact you periodically and check your condition.
Therefore, whenever you leave the Order, I will make regular contact.
Do not call it annoying! This is an essential procedure for managing my Collectible!
The matter is settled! I reject your refusal!
Accept it as another new duty at the Order.

You know, I want you to recognize more clearly that you are my Collectible, Master.
How do you think I feel when you roam everywhere and overwork yourself?
From now on, take proper responsibility for becoming my Collectible.
Of course, in return, I will manage my Collectible thoroughly.
I will contact you again. Remain well until the next call.
